protocol_plan.amendment_status: Direct-contrast postprocessing plan recorded after GPU source bundle launch and before inspection of the new main-test or confirmation ranking predictions. The horizon and frozen-versus-appended questions already appear in research_protocol.json; this amendment specifies their direct contrasts and uncertainty calculations.
protocol_plan.purpose: Postprocess already saved research-v2 predictions only. No fitting, model scoring, hyperparameter tuning, seed selection, recipe selection, or changes to frozen GPU source bundles.
protocol_plan.pairing: Match the same declared SFT initialization seed and exactly the same saved row_id, user_id, target, day, context, and factual completion; retain every target including OOV misses. Require identical complete row populations across all families and seeds within a split. Only the factual-completion metric may exclude rows with missing factual completion; exclusion must be identical across every family and seed, and row/user counts are reported separately for every metric.
protocol_plan.estimand: Candidate minus comparator, first averaging rows within user, then users, then the complete fixed set of trained SFT/RL checkpoints. All seeds are retained.

uncertainty.primary: Paired user-cluster percentile bootstrap conditional on the trained checkpoints and shared frozen reward model; identical sampled user indices across seeds.
uncertainty.additional: Training-seed-only and crossed user/seed bootstrap are exploratory with only three seeds and do not include reward-model retraining or architecture/recipe-selection uncertainty.
uncertainty.p_value: Two-sided paired sign-flip test on each user's seed-averaged difference, conditional on exchangeability of paired user differences; no causal policy-value interpretation.
uncertainty.multiplicity: Separate Holm family of all new direct contrasts times all three metrics within each dataset and split (twelve tests per family). This is separate from the original analysis and is not a study-wide multiplicity guarantee.
uncertainty.noninferiority: Not interpreted or reported for these direct contrasts. Existing bootstrap_family is reused only for paired differences, intervals, and sign-flip p-values.

interpretation.factual_completion_weighted_hit@10: Observed bounded completion of the logged target times target hit; observational, not an exposure-adjusted policy value.
interpretation.predicted_reward@10: Frozen completion-critic prediction on recommended items only; explicitly model-based secondary diagnostic, not an observed user benefit.
interpretation.horizon: H=5 and H=1 have equal update/context budgets, but H=5 has five times as many sampled actions; no compute-matched superiority claim.
interpretation.appended: Generated items are hypothetical recommendations, not observed consumption; contrast diagnoses sensitivity to artificial history.
interpretation.reward_contrasts: Retention/duration/seconds contrasts are secondary sensitivity analyses and cannot change the frozen selected recipe.
interpretation.policy_gradient: Only anchored_h5 versus matched_control isolates adding PG with the same H, KL/CE, RM context, sampling and optimizer/context budget. A validation-selected different recipe versus matched_control compares whole procedures and may also change horizon or regularization.

amendments.status: Recorded before inspection of new main-test or confirmation ranking predictions; only validation stream logs have been viewed.
amendments.change: Add anchored_h5 minus matched_control to both datasets to isolate PG at identical H=5, KL/CE weights, frozen RM history and optimizer/context budget. The PG question was already prespecified in research_protocol.json; no model or selected recipe changes.
amendments.multiplicity: The separate direct-contrast Holm family now has four contrasts times three metrics = twelve tests per dataset and heldout split, replacing nine. This is not a study-wide correction.
